requirements.quote: These planning estimates are the common quotation basis, not purchase commitments. Only POs and expressly authorised materials bind the buyer.
requirements.text: Planning estimates are not commitments; only POs and authorized materials bind the buyer.

requirements.quote: Production months start at signed mass-production (MP) release.
requirements.text: Production months begin after MP release is signed.

requirements.quote: Week 8; bring-up, interface and power verification
requirements.text: Deliver 30 units for EVT by week 8 for bring-up, interface, and power verification.

requirements.quote: Week 14; environmental, safety, EMC and security testing
requirements.text: Deliver 50 units for DVT by week 14 for environmental, safety, EMC, and security testing.

requirements.quote: Week 20; one controlled production lot on intended line
requirements.text: Deliver 300 units for PVT by week 20 for a controlled production lot.

requirements.quote: Months 1-3: 500/month; 4-6: 1,000/month; 7-12: 1,250/month
requirements.text: Deliver 12,000 units in Year 1 with specified monthly rates.

requirements.quote: 2,000/month / 3,000/month planning basis
requirements.text: Plan for 24,000 units in Year 2 and 36,000 units in Year 3.

requirements.quote: Available within 8 weeks of a written request, subject to authorised material cover
requirements.text: Provide surge capacity of 4,000 units/month within 8 weeks of request.

requirements.quote: Plan, risk register, compliance matrix, architecture and proposed BOM.
requirements.text: Provide G0 deliverables including plan, risk register, compliance matrix, architecture, and BOM by week 2.

requirements.quote: 30 units; bring-up report; DFM/DFT review; software/security design.
requirements.text: Provide G1 deliverables including 30 units, bring-up report, DFM/DFT review, and software/security design by week 8.

requirements.quote: 50 units; approved test reports; compliance file; frozen design.
requirements.text: Provide G2 deliverables including 50 units, test reports, compliance file, and frozen design by week 14.

requirements.quote: 300 units; yield/capability report; fixtures; traceability export.
requirements.text: Provide G3 deliverables including 300 units, yield report, fixtures, and traceability export by week 20.

requirements.quote: Mandatory defects closed; signed release pack; training and capacity evidence.
requirements.text: Provide G4 deliverables including defect closure, release pack, training, and capacity evidence by week 24.

requirements.quote: Submit a resourced critical-path schedule with component lead times.
requirements.text: Submit a critical-path schedule with component lead times.

requirements.quote: Notify slippage in two business days and provide a recovery plan in five.
requirements.text: Notify schedule slippage in 2 days and provide a recovery plan in 5 days.

requirements.quote: The 380 NPI units are additional to 72,000 series units and are not saleable without separate release.
requirements.text: NPI units are additional to series units and require separate release for sale.

requirements.quote: Include test-consumed units; disclose allocation and quote extra samples.
requirements.text: Include test-consumed units, disclose allocation, and quote extra samples.

requirements.quote: Hold weekly reviews through MP and monthly reviews thereafter.
requirements.text: Conduct weekly reviews through MP and monthly reviews afterward.

requirements.quote: Gate transition, tooling replication and production shipments require written buyer release.
requirements.text: Gate transitions, tooling replication, and shipments need written buyer release.

requirements.text: Buyer review takes 5 days; delays need documented schedule adjustments.
